content: Trust + conversion on real estate developer sites (2026: Vikilinks, VASUYASHII, scaleacres, aisa-x, 247realestatemarketing, webcodeskills, magicbricks): trust IS the conversion engine. Trust drivers: verifiable registration/approval numbers (RERA in India; generalize), honest project status and possession timelines, real site photos labeled vs labeled renders ('artist impression'), clear disclaimers, testimonials/reviews, developer track record (completed projects, counters), consistent facts across page/brochure/ads, frequent progress updates. Conversion drivers: fast mobile pages, short enquiry form with qualification fields (project, config, budget, timeline, locality, visit time), one-tap WhatsApp, click-to-call, site-visit booking, sticky/primary CTA, minimal form friction (38% of conversions by phone). Never force personal data to see floor plans. No artificial urgency. Do not send PII to analytics.
